verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents REST API access on its plans, an Editor API, and an official Editor MCP server. None of the evidence says it can issue API credentials, let alone scope them or limit their privileges for an agent. Since a cloud editor with a REST API could plausibly offer scoped tokens, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
